items.topic: Myanmar airstrike on displaced persons camp kills 12, say witnesses
items.article: Sat Sri Akal Dosto! Aaj hai 14 November 2026. Aao gall karde haan Myanmar airstrike on displaced persons camp kills 12, say witnesses baare.
